nodes.name: contract-state.service.ts
nodes.summary: Angular application-layer service holding reactive contract-list and single-contract state, delegating data fetching to IContractRepository and exposing signals for loading and error status.

nodes.name: ContractStateService
nodes.summary: Injectable state service that loads contract lists and single contracts through the repository abstraction, exposing Angular signals (contracts, isLoading, error, selectedContract, filters) for UI consumption.

nodes.name: contract.rules.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Unit test suite for the domain contract rules, using novelty/contract factory helpers to build fixtures and assert business logic such as status transitions and eligible actions.

nodes.name: novelty
nodes.summary: Test fixture factory building a novelty entity with sensible defaults, overridable via a partial input, used to set up contract.rules test scenarios.

nodes.name: contract
nodes.summary: Test fixture factory building a Contract aggregate with defaults and nested novelties for testing domain rule functions.

nodes.name: contract.rules.ts
nodes.summary: Central domain-rules module implementing the post-contractual business logic: computed contract status, eligible novelty actions, addition/extension value and term caps, and role-based authorization checks.

nodes.name: availableVigencias
nodes.summary: Generates the list of selectable contract 'vigencia' years spanning a fixed range around the current year.

nodes.name: getLatestNovelty
nodes.summary: Returns the most recently dated novelty on a contract by comparing parsed expedition dates, or undefined if none exist.

nodes.name: isContractSuspended
nodes.summary: Determines whether a contract's latest novelty places it in a suspended state.

nodes.name: effectiveStatus
nodes.summary: Computes the contract's effective status, overriding the stored status with SUSPENDED when applicable.

nodes.name: hasNoveltyInProgress
nodes.summary: Checks whether the contract currently has a novelty being processed, used to block conflicting actions.

nodes.name: availableActions
nodes.summary: Computes the list of novelty actions a contract is eligible for based on its current status and history, encoding the allowed post-contractual workflow transitions.

nodes.name: canAnnulNovelty
nodes.summary: Validates whether a given novelty can be annulled, checking that it is the latest novelty, the contract status, and novelty-type restrictions.

nodes.name: currentContractValue
nodes.summary: Sums the base contract value with all addition-type novelty amounts to compute the current contract value.

nodes.name: currentTermDays
nodes.summary: Computes the contract's current term in days by adding extension-related novelty days to the parsed base term.

nodes.name: maxAdditionValue
nodes.summary: Computes the maximum allowed addition value as a percentage cap (TOPE_ADICION) of the current contract value.

nodes.name: maxExtensionDays
nodes.summary: Computes the maximum allowed extension in days as a percentage cap (TOPE_PRORROGA) of the current term.

nodes.name: currentContractorDocument
nodes.summary: Resolves the contractor's current identifying document by folding assignment (cesion) novelties over the original contractor document.

nodes.name: canManageContract
nodes.summary: Determines whether a user, by role or by matching contractor document, is authorized to manage or act on a given contract.

nodes.name: contract-status.enum.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript enum defining the possible contract lifecycle statuses (e.g. active, suspended, terminated) used throughout the contratos domain.

nodes.name: contract.entity.ts
nodes.summary: Domain model defining the Contract entity and related novelty/poliza aggregate types used across the contratos domain and infrastructure layers.

nodes.name: confirm-annul-modal.component.ts
nodes.summary: Presentational Angular component rendering a confirmation modal for annulling a contract novelty, emitting confirm/dismiss events.

nodes.name: ConfirmAnnulModalComponent
nodes.summary: Dumb modal component displaying contract/novelty details and a confirm action, wrapping the shared ModalShellComponent.

nodes.name: contract-accordion.component.ts
nodes.summary: Angular component rendering a single contract as an accordion row, deriving vigencia/status/value display data via domain rules and exposing a contextual actions menu gated by user permissions.

nodes.name: ContractAccordionComponent
nodes.summary: Accordion-row component for a contract, computing derived display fields (vigencia, status, current value, read-only/blocked state) from domain rules and managing an actions dropdown menu with document-click-outside and escape handling.

nodes.name: contract-info-card.component.ts
nodes.summary: Small presentational card component displaying the contractor document and current contract value using shared formatting utilities.

nodes.name: ContractInfoCardComponent
nodes.summary: Card component that formats and displays a contract's contractor document and current value, composed inside the novelty page layout.

nodes.name: contractor-autocomplete.component.ts
nodes.summary: Reactive-forms ControlValueAccessor component providing an autocomplete input for selecting a contractor, wiring query text changes to a debounced contract-state search.

nodes.name: ContractorAutocompleteComponent
nodes.summary: Implements Angular's ControlValueAccessor to expose a contractor autocomplete as a reactive form control, syncing query text with the selected contractor and exposing basic validation.

nodes.name: dashboard-contratos.component.ts
nodes.summary: Main contratos dashboard page: search/filter form for contracts, contract list view, and confirm/execute workflows for annulling a novelty or activating a contract.

nodes.name: DashboardContratosComponent
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the contracts dashboard: filter form handling by contract number or contractor, contract list state via ContractStateService, and confirm/execute flows for annulling a novelty or activating a contract via NoveltyService.

nodes.name: modal-shell.component.ts
nodes.summary: Generic reusable modal shell component providing backdrop click, escape-key dismissal, and configurable max-width for other modal components to compose.

nodes.name: ModalShellComponent
nodes.summary: Shared modal shell that emits a dismiss event on backdrop click or Escape key, with a configurable max-width class, used as the wrapper for the app's confirmation modals.

nodes.name: format.util.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests covering the shared date, currency, and document formatting utilities, including edge cases like Spanish number-to-words conversion.

nodes.name: format.util.ts
nodes.summary: Shared formatting and calculation utilities: date parsing/formatting, Colombian peso currency formatting (including number-to-Spanish-words conversion), and contract term/day conversions used across the contratos presentation layer.

nodes.name: todayIso
nodes.summary: Returns today's date formatted as an ISO (yyyy-MM-dd) string.

nodes.name: toDisplayDate
nodes.summary: Converts an ISO date string to a localized display format for the UI.

nodes.name: addDaysToDate
nodes.summary: Adds a number of days to a given date and returns the resulting date formatted as an ISO string.

nodes.name: daysBetween
nodes.summary: Computes the whole number of days between two dates.

nodes.name: formatCop
nodes.summary: Formats a numeric value as a Colombian peso (COP) currency string using locale-aware thousands separators.

nodes.name: hundredsToWords
nodes.summary: Internal helper converting a number under one thousand into its Spanish word representation (centenas/decenas), used by the currency-to-words conversion.

nodes.name: numberToWords
nodes.summary: Converts an arbitrary numeric value into its full Spanish word representation, composing millones/miles/hundreds segments.

nodes.name: formatCopWords
nodes.summary: Formats a numeric contract value as its Spanish-words currency representation (e.g. for legal document text).

nodes.name: termToDays
nodes.summary: Parses a contract term string (e.g. containing months/days tokens) and converts it into a total number of days.

nodes.name: addDaysToTerm
nodes.summary: Adds extra days to an initial contract term string, returning both the updated term words and its numeric words representation.

nodes.name: formatDocument
nodes.summary: Formats a numeric identity/document string by grouping digits into blocks of three for display.

nodes.name: formatExecutionDate
nodes.summary: Formats a Date into localized (es-CO) date and time strings, used to display when a novelty action was executed.
